# Molekule

> Molekule manufactures FDA-cleared air purifiers and humidifiers featuring proprietary PECO technology combined with HEPA filtration for destroying airborne pollutants, allergens, viruses, and mold spores.

Molekule offers a complete ecosystem of air purification products including the Air Mini+ and Air Pro purifiers, Glow humidifier, mobile app for smart home integration, filter subscription services, and comprehensive guides for health applications like allergy relief, wildfire smoke protection, and pet dander elimination.
